accepted: structured stdout record with fresh nonce, canonical workspace, child pid, loopback URL, feed identity and leased instance identity
workspace sidecar whose lock, pid, protocol, workspace digest, endpoint digest and record digest match the child record
health response whose feed and desktop lease identities match the discovered sidecar
denied: arbitrary stdout/stderr URL without the structured ready prefix
stale or reused pid, missing lock, symlinked sidecar path, or dead child
wrong workspace, instance id, authority epoch, protocol, endpoint, or record digest
health response for another feed, instance, epoch, pid or workspace
worker action before ready and verified health
automatic session resume after close or worker restart
limits: fixtures and source guards do not prove real Electron, OS process-tree, cross-user, or durable restart behavior
